description: Creates an issue if it does not exist.

parameters.name: api_job_token
parameters.description: GitLab CI job token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_oauth_token
parameters.description: GitLab OAuth token for logging in.

parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: api_token
parameters.description: GitLab access token with API permissions.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The resolvable endpoint for the API.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The username to use for authentication against the API.

parameters.name: assignee_ids
parameters.description: A list of assignee usernames omitting @ character. Set to an empty array to unassign all assignees.

parameters.name: ca_path
parameters.description: The CA certificates bundle to use to verify GitLab server certificate.

parameters.name: description
parameters.description: A description of the issue. Gets overridden by a content of file specified at description_path, if found.

parameters.name: description_path
parameters.description: A path of file containing issue’s description. Accepts MarkDown formatted files.

parameters.name: labels
parameters.description: A list of label names. Set to an empty array to remove all labels.

parameters.name: milestone_group_id
parameters.description: The path or numeric ID of the group hosting desired milestone.

parameters.name: milestone_search
parameters.description: The name of the milestone. Set to empty string to unassign milestone.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The path or name of the project.

parameters.name: state_filter
parameters.description: Filter specifying state of issues while searching. Choices: "opened" ← (default) "closed"

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: A title for the issue. The title is used as a unique identifier to ensure idempotency.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether or not to validate SSL certs when supplying a HTTPS endpoint. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create Issue
  community.general.gitlab_issue:
    api_url: https://gitlab.com
    api_token: secret_access_token
    project: "group1/project1"
    title: "Ansible demo Issue"
    description: "Demo Issue description"
    labels:
      - Ansible
      - Demo
    assignee_ids:
      - testassignee
    state_filter: "opened"
    state: present

- name: Delete Issue
  community.general.gitlab_issue:
    api_url: https://gitlab.com
    api_token: secret_access_token
    project: "group1/project1"
    title: "Ansible demo Issue"
    state_filter: "opened"
    state: absent

return_values.name: msg
return_values.description: Success or failure message. Returned: always Sample: "Success"
